name: Human-gated wallet check
whenToUse: Use when an agent needs to assess an Ethereum address and must pause before a paid or consequential follow-up.
why: The result depends on both live The Graph evidence and our World ID human gate: without Graph there is no risk decision, and without the gate there is no approval.

how.operation: Read wallet activity and risk evidence for the address.
POST /api/gateway/gate with the address and intent; return the approvalUrl to a human.
Poll GET /api/gateway/gate?actionId=... and proceed only when status is approved.
